8.20.3. iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods.assertNonEmpty¶

iLock_Geography.lcf.table_methods.assertNonEmpty(lst, attrib)¶

Convenience function for table method argument validation.

Raises an error if lst is empty.

Parameters:
  • lst (list) – List to check.
  • attrib (str) – Name of attribute that is validated (for error messages)
